name: restaurant-ordering
description: Real-time restaurant ordering prototype: Angular client + Node.js server

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.start:demo: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run start:demo -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.start:chaos: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run start:chaos -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
